name: Mission Hospital (main campus, incl. Mission Children's Hospital)
operator: Mission Health / HCA Healthcare (MH Mission Hospital, LLLP)
notes: Adult ER plus a dedicated pediatric ER (North Tower); Mission Children's Hospital is on the 3rd floor of the main building. ER entrance = Entrance 1 at the main hospital, 24/7. Air medical: Mountain Area Medical Airlift (MAMA). Context: hospital has had repeated CMS 'immediate jeopardy' findings (BPR, Dec 2025). Correction to the brief: Mission is no longer Level II.

name: Mission Hospital - St. Joseph campus
notes: Mission's official materials list the adult and pediatric ERs only at the main hospital (509 Biltmore Ave); the Mission locations page lists 'South Asheville ER' as the only other ER. One aggregator (Vivian Health) claims an ED here; treat it as unreliable. Do not route 911 ambulances here unless confirmed locally.

name: South Asheville ER (Mission Hospital freestanding ED)
operator: Mission Health / HCA Healthcare (licensed as part of Mission Hospital)
address: 2512 Hendersonville Rd, Arden, NC 28704 (corner of Airport Rd and Hendersonville Rd)
notes: 24/7; ~11,000 sq ft; 11 exam rooms (the CON planned 12 treatment rooms incl. 1 trauma/resuscitation room), CT, X-ray, ultrasound, lab. Mission says it gives 'EMS partners a place for critical patients to be stabilized before transport to an inpatient hospital'; actual Buncombe EMS destination rules for this site not verified. CON projected ~9,248 visits in CY2025 and ~10,400 by CY2027. Phone 828-376-7100.

name: Charles George VA Medical Center
notes: ED open 24/7 to walk-ins (turn right at the front entrance). Serves WNC, upstate SC, north GA and east TN veterans. How Buncombe EMS chooses this destination for veterans was not verified.
